text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown devised a strategy to defeat 
Duramente. To secure victory, the entire 
Satono family joined in for special 
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Duramente's fighting spirit 
burned bright. To become the strongest, 
she would thoroughly crush the wall 
standing in her way... Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby is just around the 
corner—!
